Cc: Aurora Health Security <security@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Kickoff: evidence bridgework & portal sync for Aurora / Redwood

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on — we need to get Redwood's profiles and evidence lined up across the portals (Whistic + Vendr) so our procurement and infosec teams can finish the assessment this quarter. To avoid duplicate uploads and stale artifacts, would you be able to:  

- Confirm a single point of contact at Redwood for the next two weeks (portal invites + evidences).
- Share your preferred manifest format for SOC 2 / CAIQ / SIG artifacts (we currently accept PDFs, PNG diagrams, and a CAIQ CSV).
- Confirm whether Redwood prefers us to push artifacts into your Whistic profile or if you will upload on your side.

I've attached a short inventory template (Attachment: MAP-Aurora-Redwood-20260912.docx) and a list of required items from our side: SOC 2 (redacted), network diagram, vendor contact for infra questions.

We can also provision read-only access in Vendr if that makes the handoff simpler — I can send invites once we align.

Best,
Elena Soto
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Aurora Health

[Attachment: MAP-Aurora-Redwood-20260912.docx (docx)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: evidence bridgework & portal sync for Aurora / Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the inventory template. Happy to be the main point of contact for this work. Quick plan proposal below and two asks for you.

Proposed 10-business-day plan (start: Sep 13):
1) Day 1: mutual action plan (MAP) agreed and shared Drive folder provisioned.
2) Days 2–6: Redwood collates SOC 2 redacted PDF, CAIQ answers (CSV), and network diagram; uploads primary artifacts to our staging folder.
3) Days 6–8: joint review — Aurora checks the staging artifacts and we resolve any missing controls.
4) Days 9–10: final push to portal(s) and confirmation to procurement.

Asks for Aurora:  
- Please confirm whether you prefer us to accept your portal uploads (Aurora pushes into our Whistic profile) or for Redwood to upload directly to Vendr/Whistic. Either works; Aurora push would be faster.
- Can you share the Vendr/Whistic invite links (or the specific vendor IDs) and a short list of required controls that trigger procurement acceptance?

I'll assign tasks internally: Karthik will handle the CAIQ/SIG mapping, Marcus will manage portal provisioning and uploads, and Mina will own SOC 2 redaction and audit-line items.

Proposed times for a short 30-min sync this week: Mon 9/14 09:00–11:00 PT or Tue 9/15 14:00–16:00 PT. Let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Irene Choi
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference
